\title{A Toy Paper}\author{Test Author}\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
The method reaches 95\% accuracy on the test set. It runs in 1.39 ms per frame.
It beats the baseline. We train the classifier in three stages.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
Prior work uses Kalman filters. This paper learns the mapping instead.
\section{Methods}
We train a classifier in three stages, each starting from the previous weights.
\section{Results}
The classifier reaches 95.2\% accuracy on the test set. Latency is 1.388 ms per frame.
Stage 2 is evaluated second. The method is twice as fast as the older design.
\section{Conclusion}
The classifier is accurate and fast.
